audit.why: 50.83% over 543 games. EVEN / 6-10 is right: Fiora owns levels 1-3, Shen turns the lane into a map question at 6 with Stand United.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Levels 2 and 3 away to Skill/Shen and gave Level 6 to Fiora, contradicting both the packet chart and the page's own prose.
audit.why: whys[1] and whys[2] both describe Fiora dominating levels 2-3 (Bladework crit Vital, chained Lunges off Vital procs). whys[4] and spikes[1] both say level 6 flips to Shen because Stand United is global. The packet chart (Fiora/Fiora/Fiora/Skill/Shen/Skill/Shen) already matches the prose.
audit.corrected: Levels 2 and 3 -> Fiora, Levels 4-5 -> Skill, Level 6 -> Shen, First item -> Skill; phases[4].why rewritten so the reason matches the side.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never mentions that Stand United is a channel that can be interrupted.
audit.why: The kit flags Shen's R as 'channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it': he shields the ally first, then teleports after a delay. Hard CC on Shen during that window cancels the teleport, which is the single highest-value thing a Fiora can do to a Shen — she is the champion standing next to him when he casts it. Riposte stuns when it parries an immobilizing effect, and Shadow Dash is exactly that, so a taunt parried into a stun is an ult cancel.
audit.corrected: Stand United is a channel — a Riposte stun off his taunt cancels it and strands his team in a 5v4.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shadow Dash is named as the cooldown to track with no duration given.
audit.why: Shadow Dash is 18/16/14/12/10s and costs a flat 150 mana — a huge early window when it is down.
audit.corrected: Taunt dash, 18s at rank 1. Engage only once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Grand Challenge paints four vitals and the heal field wins any committed duel. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Shen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: You win the local all-in at 6, but Stand United is global on a 200s cooldown — his ult converts across the map while yours only wins the duel.

edits.after: Stand United is a channel — a Riposte stun off his taunt cancels it and strands his team in a 5v4

edits.after: Taunt dash, 18s at rank 1. Engage only once it is down or baited.

notes: Chart moved onto the packet, which already agreed with the page's prose. The ult-cancel line is the one addition; it is written as 'a Riposte stun cancels it' rather than 'Riposte cancels it', because Riposte's default return is a slow and a slow is not an interrupt — only the immobilize-parry stun is.
